newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL BOSS AT ODDS WITH HODDLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL BOSS AT ODDS WITH HODDLE.

text.p: Liverpool manager Roy Evans is on collision course with England manager Glenn Hoddle regarding the international availability of Robbie Fowler and Steve McManaman.
Both players are wanted for England's World Cup qualifier against Poland on May 31 as well as a friendly against South Africa the previous week and three more games in France next month.

But Evans claims Fowler, who has been complaining of breathing problems, and McManaman, who is carrying a knee injury, require surgery before the start of the season and wants the pair to put club before country.
"You wouldn't expect England to be sympathetic," said Evans. "They want their pound of flesh but we pay the wages and we stand to be the biggest losers."
Hoddle wants both players to be examined by England's medical staff next week before making any decision to release them from the squad.
